name: World Weather Online
tagline: Multi-product weather, marine, ski, and historical weather API with free trial
description: World Weather Online provides weather, marine, ski, and historical weather data APIs for developers. It offers current conditions, forecasts, historical weather, and specialized products through a REST API with free trial access.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY, self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free trial tier available; concrete limits unknown from research

use_cases: get current weather for a city
retrieve historical weather for a location
